leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a form in Vue using v-model to bind input fields to reactive data properties.
Implement form validation by applying computed properties or watchers to check user input against defined rules.
Configure conditional rendering to display validation error messages based on the state of the form data.
Integrate form submission handling by preventing default browser behavior and processing validated data.
Manipulate form state to reset input fields and clear validation errors upon successful submission.
Initialize a Vue component with reactive data structures suitable for managing multiple form fields and their validation status.
